page.layout: One page of verse in the main column; marginal notes in the right margin, running down beside the lines. Running head AFRICA at top, page number 169 at top right.

main_text.p: Nare sagax e calle feras, perterrita lateMarmaridæ populi. Agmina precipitant volucres formidine cerui: Hos agit haud lato vultu, ne fronte serena Hasbytes casa nuper germanus Acheras. Marmaridæ, medicum vulgus strepuere cateruis:Bamuræ po. Ad quorum cantus serpens oblita veneni, Ad quorum cantus mites iacuere cerasta. Tum chalybis pauper Bamuræ cruda iuuentus, Contenti parca durasse hastilia flamma, Miscebant auidi trucibus fera murmura linguis.Autololes populi. Necnon Autololes leuibus gens ignea plantis, Cui sonipes cursu, cui cesserit incitus amnis, Tanta fuga est, certant penna, campumque volatu Cum rapuere, pedum frustra vestigia quaras. Spectati castris, quo succo nobilis arbor, Et dulci pascit Lotos nimis hospita bacca.Lotophagi populi. Quique atro rapidas efferuescente veneno Dypsadas immensis horrent Garamantes arenis.Garamantes populi Serpentibus abundant. Fama docet casa rapuit cum Gorgonis ora Perseus, in Libya dirum fluxisse cruorem, Inde Medusæis terram exundasse Chelydris. Milibus his ductor spectatus marte Choaspes Neritia Meninge satus, cui tragula semper Fulmineam armabat, celebratum missile, dextram.Nasamone s populi. Hinc coit aequoreus Nasamon inuadere fluctu Audax naufragia, & prædas auellere ponto.Tritonidis palus. Hinc qui stagna colunt Tritonidos alta paludis, Quà virgo (vt fama est) bellatrix edita lympha Inuento primam Libyen perfudit oliuo. Æstifero Libye torquetur subdita Cancro,Sil. Itu l. li. r. Aut ingens Asia latus, aut pars tertia terris. Terminus huic rosens amnis Lageus adortus Septeno impellens tumefactum gurgite pontum.Africa a vtrū terci a pars orbi so.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are small and partly damaged; readings of the abbreviated notes (Bamuræ po., Sil. Itu, Africa a vtrū terci a pars orbi so.) are doubtful. Right margin notes were placed at the line where they stand. Some words in the verse are blurred and may be misread.
